title: Domain selection for UE originating sessions / calls

entities.name: Domain selection procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE domain selection based on UE usage setting, IMS voice availability, and registration mode.

entities.name: UE usage setting
entities.description: UE configuration parameter that can be 'voice centric' or 'data centric'.

entities.name: IMS voice available over 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition that evaluates to true when UE supports IMS voice over 3GPP access and network supports IMS voice over PS sessions.

entities.name: IMS voice not available over 3GPP access
entities.description: Condition that evaluates to true when UE does not support IMS voice, network indicates no support, or upper layers indicate unavailability.

entities.name: IMS voice available over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition that evaluates to true when UE supports IMS voice over non-3GPP access connected to 5GCN.

entities.name: IMS voice not available over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Condition that evaluates to true when UE does not support IMS voice over non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Single-registration mode
entities.description: UE registration mode where UE maintains registration in only one core network at a time.

entities.name: Dual-registration mode
entities.description: UE registration mode where UE can maintain registration in multiple core networks simultaneously.

entities.name: N1 mode capability disable
entities.description: Procedure to disable N1 mode capability for 3GPP or non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Persistent PDU session
entities.description: PDU session that remains active until explicitly released.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Network message that indicates whether IMS voice over PS sessions are supported.

relations.description: Domain selection procedure behavior is determined by UE usage setting.
Domain selection procedure behavior is determined by IMS voice availability over 3GPP access.
Domain selection procedure behavior is determined by IMS voice availability over non-3GPP access.
Domain selection procedure behavior is determined by single-registration mode operation.
When IMS voice is not available over 3GPP access and UE usage setting is voice centric, UE disables N1 mode capability.
When IMS voice is not available over non-3GPP access and UE usage setting is voice centric, UE disables N1 mode capability.
Presence of persistent PDU session delays N1 mode capability disable until radio bearer is released.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message indicates whether IMS voice over PS sessions are supported.
